name: Tagify User List
description: Provides a Tagify user-list widget showing avatars and info for user reference fields.
project_description:
Tagify module integrates Drupal autocomplete and Tagify component, providing a widget that significantly enhances the usability of entity reference fields. This widget seamlessly transforms these fields into an intuitive tags input component, promoting user-friendliness and optimising performance. The result is a smoother and more efficient user experience.

 
 The Tagify module is now included in Drupal CMS as default widget for entity reference fields. For more details, visit the next link .

 
 Try Tagify in Drupal CMS 

 Back to top 

 Key features 
 
 Modern Tag Styling 
 Adopt a modern tag style that brings a fresh and visually appealing look to the entity reference fields.

 Duplicate Tag Prevention 
 Automatically disallows the inclusion of duplicate tags, promoting data consistency and user convenience.

 Adaptive Label Management 
 Automatically deactivates labels when the predefined limit in Drupal is exceeded, ensuring efficient label control.

 Tag Creation 
 Adapts to Drupal settings by allowing or disallowing tag creation based on specified preferences.

 Intuitive Drag & Sort 
 Enhance user interaction by enabling the effortless organisation of tags through a drag-and-sort feature.

 Highlight Input Matching 
 Improve user experience by highlighting input matching in the suggestions dropdown, aiding users in selecting the correct tags efficiently.

 A11Y Accessibility 
 Enhance accessibility features to ensure that users with disabilities can navigate and interact with the tags.

 Select Widget 
 Supports single/multiple select listings, enabling users to efficiently choose from a predefined list of tags.

 Form Element 
 Enhance your custom forms by adding a powerful autocomplete element, integrating Drupal's autocomplete with the Tagify component for efficient and user-friendly tag selection.

 Hierarchical Support 
 Organise taxonomy terms hierarchically in the suggestions dropdown, with child terms grouped under parent categories. Configurable parent selection and visual grouping enhance navigation and maintain data structure integrity.
